name: studyrevr
description: Open-source, mobile-first study app: upload a lesson, get a review, flashcards, and mock quizzes.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.study: npm run build -w client && npm run start -w server
